title: An Idea Becomes a System (Voxel Art preview)

scenes.title: One block, then many
scenes.purpose: Show a single glowing idea block that grows, block by block, into a connected voxel system on a night-slate stage, with the headline building alongside it.
visuals: Exact-isometric orthographic Three.js view of unit cubes (one InstancedMesh, one BoxGeometry) on a stepped slate plateau
Terracotta seed block with a warm local light pool
Teal path, branch and stacks connecting terracotta-and-cream towers
Opaque slate copy panel on the right with cream monospace headline, a teal rule and three palette swatches
assets: voxel-scene.bundle.js (local esbuild bundle of src/voxel-scene.js and three)

beats.development: The seed idea block drops onto the empty plateau and flares, casting warm terracotta light on the ground; the kicker and AN IDEA slide in.
Blocks fall into place in order of graph distance from the seed: the left tower rises, then the teal path, the branch, the stacks, the turn and the right tower land. BECOMES A appears.
A light pulse travels outward from the idea through every connected block and leaves the network softly lit. SYSTEM, its teal rule and the palette swatches resolve.
Settled hold: the complete lit voxel system and the full headline are readable.

findings: Every block has landed by about 1.70s and the pulse has settled by about 2.46s, so the full scene is complete before 2.7s.
Each headline line appears in step with the build stage it describes.
justifiedHolds: The 0.5s closing hold (2.5–3.0s) gives time to read the complete headline and system.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.

No reviewed preview recipe was supplied (STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes and the optional recipe list is empty). This refresh instead demonstrates the source-frame background lesson: a night-slate stage lit by a local warm source instead of the earlier cream canvas.
